items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: they had a place they called a Tin Top on Padilla and Liberty.

ctx.x: I'm not sure about this, but as I remember, I've been to anniversaries and funerals both, with the Zulus, where they have the Bethlehem with them. It seems strange.
Well, the Bethlehem was a, was a little side club they had down there. And, uh, that club started in, uh, what you call, I think it was, they had a place they called a Tin Top on Padilla and Liberty.
